verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that ScrapingBee documents an official MCP server at mcp.scrapingbee.com, so an agent can connect through a first-party server. The evidence is a single probe line with no detail on the tools exposed, the transport or auth setup, or client configuration. Missing for 10: documentation of which scraping/search APIs the MCP server exposes as tools, setup and auth instructions for agent clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration of it working.
